title: BigP3BCI Study N — 9x8 dry/wet electrode comparison (8 ALS subjects)
description: This dataset is a BIDS-formatted derivative of Study N from the bigP3BCI collection, a large public P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) resource. It contains 16-channel EEG recorded over two sessions from 8 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) using a 9x8 character speller grid. The study compares dry and wet electrodes, with target and non-target flash events annotated with HED tags.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) at 256 Hz from 16 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage. Participants used a visual P300 speller with online feedback in a laboratory setting. Target and non-target stimuli were labeled, and trials covered a 0-1.0 s interval. The line frequency was 60 Hz.
